$comment: Codex-audit rubric decisions (R528: every resilience decision is a named setting). Today's choice is the value. Resolved by scripts/lib/audit-settings.mjs from the TRUSTED RUNNING checkout, never from a candidate diff. Cascade: standard, platform preference 'audit', this file, then env (env may only TIGHTEN). Any unreadable or invalid value resolves to the strictest option. verdict.mode: shadow (model AND computed must pass) | model | computed. preExisting.mode: block | prove | allow (allow resolves to block with a warning). releaseStage: prerelease | prod. guardFloorPaths: E findings here always block; the built-in floor (GUARD_FLOOR) already holds these entries and every guard and lease module, so removing one here never unprotects it. priorQuestionHashes: [{hash, acceptUntil}] question hashes still accepted by findAudit until acceptUntil. The previous whole-diff question is accepted through 2026-12-24; older records still obey the 30-day window. debounce.minutes: positive integer, default and unreadable fallback 5 (WE_AUDIT_DEBOUNCE_MINUTES may increase). delta.maxFiles: nonnegative integer, default 0 (delta OFF until the hardening card lands), invalid/unreadable 0 = FULL (WE_AUDIT_DELTA_MAX_FILES may decrease). hunkContextLines: integer 0–3, default 3, invalid/unreadable 0; WE_AUDIT_HUNK_CONTEXT_LINES may only decrease. Context resolves in scripts/lib/audit-settings.mjs. Efficiency settings resolve in codex-audit.mjs.
